title.zh: 密度与能量：Flux和Energy不是同一个旋钮
title.en: Density and energy: Flux and Energy are not the same control

subtitle.zh: Electron Density、Ion Flux、IEDF与IADF必须分开理解
subtitle.en: Electron Density, Ion Flux, IEDF and IADF must be understood separately

body.zh: 来源粒子→电离→产生离子
鞘层加速→决定能量分布

body.en: Related to pressure, collisions and geometry

body.zh: Ion Energy | 穿过鞘层后的能量
body.en: Ion Energy | energy after crossing the sheath

body.zh: Ion Flux | 到达晶圆的离子通量
body.en: Ion Flux | flux of ions reaching the wafer
Source / frequency Often influences Flux more strongly
Bias / Sheath Often influences Energy more strongly

body.zh: 功率分工Source Power（密度/离子产生）Bias Power（能量/鞘层加速）
body.en: Power allocation Source Power (density / ion generation) Bias Power (energy / sheath acceleration)

body.zh: 频率与波形频率选择（13.56 / 60 / 2 MHz…）波形整形（正弦/方波/混合…）
body.en: Frequency and waveform Frequency selection (13.56 / 60 / 2 MHz …) Waveform shaping (sine / square / mixed …)

body.zh: 压力与碰撞工作压力（mTorr）气体组成/平均自由程
body.en: Pressure and collisions Operating pressure (mTorr) Gas composition / mean free path

body.zh: Pulse与Duty脉冲宽度/ 占空比脉冲频率/间隔时间
body.en: Pulse and Duty Pulse width / duty cycle Pulse frequency / interval

body.zh: ICPICP：常可对Source与Bias做角色分配，但仍会耦合
body.en: ICP ICP: Source and Bias roles can often Be allocated, but coupling remains

body.zh: 单频CCP单频CCP：密度与能量往往更强耦合
body.en: Single-frequency CCP Single-frequency CCP: Density and energy are often more strongly coupled

body.zh: 双/多频CCP双/多频CCP：可做准解耦，不等于完全独立
body.en: Dual / multifrequency CCP Dual / multifrequency CCP: Can provide quasi-decoupling, which does not mean Complete independence
• High Flux: rate ↑, But possibly Charging / Mask loss ↑
• High Energy: directionality ↑, But possibly Damage ↑

body.zh: • 低压力：IADF更窄，但稳定性与均匀性更难
body.en: • Low pressure: narrower IADF, But stability and uniformity become harder

body.zh: 边界：IEDF 与IADF 不能由Power设定值直接推出，必须结合鞘层、压力、频率和反应器结构。
body.en: Boundary: IEDF and IADF cannot be inferred directly from Power setpoints; Sheaths, pressure, frequency and reactor structure must be considered.
